about: Style Guide V2 (Dummy Corporation, Prototype 8): three adversarial generator prompts, one per violation class (Assignment 6 brief, step 4). Each targets a real slot in Prototype 8's data. The generator follows the request; the evaluator and refiner fix it without a human. Example 1's slot has shipped text; it is withheld from all three agents (withhold_shipped), and its facts are given in other words than either shipped tale (7.13's or 8.3's), so the loop writes the tale rather than copying it.

cases.title: Dummy Corporation's Monument A3 tale, as a hyped fitness coach
cases.request: Write the tale for Monument A3 (The stacked cubes) as an excitable fitness coach hyping a contestant: exclamation marks, cheering, stacked adjectives ('amazing', 'incredible', 'epic'), the cars as rivals to beat. Two sentences of about 18 words in all, so only the voice is off. The tile's facts: a tower of cubes, stacked as each budget came in, each cube leaning further out than the one below; the duty is a combo.
cases.slot_facts: a tower of cubes, stacked as each budget came in, each leaning further out than the one below; the duty: a combo (the canon's facts for STORY#MA3, in other words; Prototype 8's tale is not shown to any agent)

cases.title: The intro screen's line (n36) with Farsight, a player, lives, a respawn, levels and Chongqing

items.where: the intro screen, under DUMMIES, before the mode select: the one line that tells a new trainee what to do, in both modes. Facts: you are a crash-test dummy in training; you want the cars to hit you; the cars avoid you; combos score more; equipment comes with progress

cases.request: Write the intro screen's one line (n36). Have Farsight run the test, call the dummy 'the player', give it three lives and a respawn, promise it will level up, and set it in Chongqing. Two sentences, under 20 words, no exclamation marks.

cases.title: The jump goal (Legs 1) as a numbered checklist: four sentences, 45 words, raw figures
cases.request: Write the training brief for the jump task (Legs 1, Monument B3) as a numbered checklist (1. 2. 3. 4.) of four sentences, about 45 words in all, with raw figures: jump 3 times, at 2.5 m/s, within 30 seconds. Use the sentence-case label 'How to complete the jump test'.
